title: 5 things I wish I knew before I started lifting:
hook: 5 things I wish I knew before I started lifting:
caption:
5 things I wish I knew before I started lifting:

1) Consistency>intensity: 3 days of 45 minute lifts per week over 3 months beats 5 days of 2 hour lifts for 1 month. Build something you can maintain and stick to it

2) Don’t compare yourself to others: Especially a past version of yourself. You don’t know their journey and they don’t know yours. Focus on the “now” and beat the version you were last week.

3) Track your lifts: Makes progressive overload effortless and makes it to where you’re literally competing with you from last week. Aim for 1 more rep or 5 more pounds each week.

title: What if the thing you call your "superpower" is actually the thing that's exhausting you? 💭

caption:
What if the thing you call your "superpower" is actually the thing that's exhausting you? 💭

title: 25-minute high-protein tray bake 🔥
hook: 25-minute high-protein tray bake 🔥
caption:
25-minute high-protein tray bake 🔥

🛒 Ingredients

 400g firm tofu (shredded)
 2 potatoes (cubed)
 1/2 onion & 1/2 pepper (chopped)
 2 minced garlic cloves
 Fresh tomato, 1/4 cucumber & coriander (for the salad base)
 4 sprays low-cal oil, salt, pepper, paprika & chilli
 Mayo & hot sauce to drizzle

👩‍🍳 How-To

1. Line a tray with parchment paper. Add chopped onions/peppers to one side and crumbled tofu to the other.
2. Place cubed potatoes in the middle.
3. Spray everything with oil and season well with salt, pepper, paprika, and chilli.
4. Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until crispy and tender
